title: Create reproducible durable Calibration runs

verify.summary: Independent verifier reproduced that the Calibration snapshot accepts an Attempt with no annotations, although FT-011-AC-003 requires applicable annotated Attempts and the ground-truth contract excludes missing ground truth. Focused gates passed but do not cover this violation; task lifecycle remains in_progress for executor correction.

Fresh verification confirms the accepted Calibration contract: a request selects existing Attempt UUIDs, persisted applicable annotations are frozen from the diagnostics owner, and a selection with no persisted annotations cannot create a Calibration run. All task gates passed.

evidence_required: FT-011-AC-003 RED: no diagnostics-owned Calibration run can freeze existing Photo identities/digests plus applicable annotated Attempts, evaluate the same verified JPEG bytes through the named native adapters, or retain separately attributable same-dataset results; GREEN: one next-linear run store and diagnostics-to-processing operation persist the immutable bounded snapshot, pass identical verified source bytes and selection to SFace and Buffalo M without reupload, keep results separate by run/dataset/revision, fail unavailable input without shrinking, and compare only complete results with the same dataset hash; decisive comparison: disposable migration/repository plus two-adapter fixtures inspect byte digests, selection, stored identities/results, mismatch rejection and unchanged Photo/Attempt/annotation/serving state; artifact: focused redacted output under .tasks/TASK-100-T2-FT-011-W1/.
purpose: Provide the smallest durable Calibration execution result that later recommendation, worker and developer-flow tasks can consume without inventing a dataset catalog or experiment platform.
success_outcome: One immutable selected dataset is evaluated through the two existing native pipelines from identical verified Photo bytes, and its separate reproducible results support only same-dataset before/after comparison.
anti_goals: Do not implement threshold or quality recommendations, staff routes, worker scheduling, apply, promotion or retention.
Do not add a model registry, dataset/history table, generic job system, upload path, embedding store or arbitrary optimizer.
Do not mutate inventory Photos, Promo Attempts, annotations or serving settings.

forbidden_scope: Production PostgreSQL/MinIO, operator/default data and real participant names in task artifacts
Direct writes to inventory, promo, annotation or serving-control owner state
Worker scheduling/recovery, recommendation algorithms, staff HTTP, apply and retention behavior
stop_conditions: The immutable run cannot reuse existing Photo originals and annotation/Attempt projections without a new upload or dataset platform.
Offline evaluation requires a new model registry, combined cross-pipeline embeddings/results or an ownership edge outside the accepted boundary map.
The migration cannot remain next-linear in the shared schema/Base/Alembic stream.

constraints: Primary owner is diagnostics at src/face_moment/diagnostics/; processing resolves inventory-owned originals and executes only its existing direct SFace/Buffalo M adapters through the accepted edge.
Create one next-linear calibration_runs migration from the execution-time direct predecessor and prove only this revision's upgrade/downgrade, schema transition and preserved predecessor data.
Freeze one SPA, unique Photo UUID/digest pairs, applicable Attempt/annotation input, the two eligible revision identities, current settings and finite candidate lists in a bounded canonical snapshot.
Read and digest-check each selected original once; missing or changed required input records dataset_unavailable and never silently changes the dataset.
Use only synthetic/disposable selections and redacted artifacts, with safe rerun and complete fixture cleanup.
invariants: Dataset input and terminal result remain immutable and contain no embeddings, secrets, tokens, arbitrary request bodies or object-store keys.
Results remain separate by run, dataset hash and pipeline revision; no cross-pipeline result or embedding is published.
Diagnostics, processing, inventory, promo and serving_control retain their accepted write ownership.
verification_targets: Disposable migration/repository fixtures prove the one-table bounded shape, valid transitions, immutable snapshot/result and upgrade/downgrade with linear ancestry.

Cross-slice fixtures prove one verified read of each selected JPEG, byte-identical input plus the same applicable Attempt selection for both native adapters, separate stored revision results and no reupload or foreign writes.

Application fixtures prove dataset_unavailable on missing/digest-mismatched input and dataset_mismatch for before/after across unequal hashes while valid same-hash aggregates reconcile to contributing Attempts.
